settings.visualStyle: AI-generated historical reenactment styled as black-and-white 35mm Guadalcanal 1942 wartime field-newsreel footage. Dense wet tropical jungle, mud, rain, shallow streams, foxholes, period-correct U.S. Marine uniforms and weapons. Moderate grain, gate weave, dust, scratches, flicker, soft optics and imperfect exposure. Non-graphic combat only. No modern objects, HDR, drone, gimbal, glossy lighting or game-like framing.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. A human wartime cameraman is physically embedded with the Marine patrol. He must push through leaves, step over roots, cross water, drop behind logs, squeeze into muddy foxholes, react late to sudden fire and endure rain on the lens. Visibility is limited by jungle geometry; the camera cannot see through vegetation or float above canopy. No dialogue, narration, subtitles or music. Diegetic sound only.
settings.customVisualStyle: Human-operated jungle field-camera realism: wet leaves repeatedly occlude the lens, water droplets and mud at frame edges, humidity softens contrast, focus hunts through foliage, operator breath is audible, running is short and unstable, and stillness is broken only by cautious peeks or sudden reactions.

movie.plotDetails: A fictional U.S. Marine scout anchors continuity while a physically present cameraman shares the same wet patrol route and cover.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create a two-minute Guadalcanal jungle reenactment as if a human wartime correspondent were physically embedded with a Marine patrol. Camera must obey vegetation, rain, roots, streams, foxholes and human reaction time. Follow humid patrol movement, listening pause, stream crossing, sudden contact, muddy foxhole, tropical rain, short repositioning, exhaustion, dusk and dawn. Black-and-white 35mm newsreel treatment. No dialogue, narration or music. Non-graphic and period accurate.
movie.storySummary: A Marine patrol moves through wet jungle, stops to listen, crosses a stream and is driven into muddy cover by sudden fire. The lead Marine fights briefly, repositions, watches the flank, endures rain and fatigue, then moves again through dusk, night flashes and misty dawn. The cameraman remains trapped inside the same vegetation and weather.
movie.storyTitle: WWII FRONTLINE FOOTAGE EP07 — Guadalcanal: Jungle Frontline

scenes.title: Humid Trail
scenes.description: A Marine patrol moves through dense tropical canopy.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine pushes a broad wet leaf aside and continues.
scenes.imageDescription: Guadalcanal 1942, dense jungle, U.S. Marines, netted helmet, mud and humidity, black-and-white 35mm grain.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman follows one meter behind; leaves repeatedly brush across and obscure the lens, footing over roots causes irregular sway, humidity softens focus. Audio: insects, wet leaves, mud, gear, breathing.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator remains immediately behind patrol on same trail.

scenes.title: Listen
scenes.description: The patrol freezes as jungle sound changes.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine raises one hand and listens.
scenes.imageDescription: Still patrol among vines and ferns, short sightlines, rifle low.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator halts a half-step late and nearly bumps the man ahead; camera settles behind a leaf cluster, leaving part of frame obscured. Near-still human-held view with breathing drift. Audio: insects soften, bird call, distant water, breath.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera remains behind scout as movement resumes toward stream.

scenes.title: Stream Crossing
scenes.description: The patrol crosses shallow rocky water.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine steps from rock to muddy bank.
scenes.imageDescription: Shallow tropical stream, roots, wet rocks, Marines crossing.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman crosses too, looking down at boots and water for balance; splash hits lens edge and horizon tilts during step onto bank. No camera on opposite bank before troops. Audio: water, rocks, fabric, jungle ambience.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator reaches muddy far bank behind patrol.

scenes.title: Jungle Erupts
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine dives behind roots and a fallen log.
scenes.imageDescription: Dense jungle contact, wet leaves, Marines diving to cover, no gore.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator reacts to soldiers dropping before fully understanding the fire; camera crashes low behind root mass, frame filled by leaf and sleeve for a moment, focus recovers late. Audio: rifle fire, leaf impacts, hard breathing.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera low behind same fallen log.

scenes.title: Mud Foxhole
scenes.description: The Marine reaches a shallow muddy fighting hole.
scenes.actionDescription: He drops into foxhole and steadies rifle.
scenes.imageDescription: Mud foxhole, wet logs, roots, rain-dark soil, same Marine.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman drops into the cramped hole behind him; wall and soldier’s back block much of frame, camera smears with mud at lower edge, then finds a narrow angle over log. Audio: mud, gear, nearby gunfire, insects.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator remains squeezed into same foxhole.

scenes.title: Short Return Fire
scenes.description: The Marine fires toward separated hostile vegetation.
scenes.actionDescription: He fires briefly then lowers weapon.
scenes.imageDescription: Foxhole firing position, dense foliage, brief muzzle flash, no close enemy.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator films from just behind shoulder with log edge blocking lower frame; he lifts only enough to catch brief firing and ducks when leaves snap nearby. Audio: short rifle fire, leaf movement, distant answering shots.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera drops back below log edge.

scenes.title: Rain Comes Hard
scenes.description: Tropical rain thickens over the position.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine stays low as rain fills puddles.
scenes.imageDescription: Heavy tropical rain, water off helmet, muddy foxhole, no firing.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator stays huddled in same hole; droplets build on lens, one large drop distorts center until it slides away, hands shake slightly from cramped posture. Audio: heavy rain, water, breath, distant muffled shots.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Lens remains wet as group prepares to relocate.

scenes.title: Move Through Ferns
scenes.description: A small group repositions through thick cover.
scenes.imageDescription: Waist-high ferns, wet leaves, mud spray, Marines relocating.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman follows last, fern leaves slap lens and hide subjects; short unstable crouch-run with no clean side profile, ending behind root cover. Audio: foliage, boots, gear, rain easing.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator arrives near stream flank behind group.

scenes.title: Check the Stream Flank
scenes.description: The patrol studies stream bank while firing fades.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine kneels beside roots and scans downstream.
scenes.imageDescription: Stream after rain, dripping roots, muddy bank, rifle lowered.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator kneels a step behind and peers around roots; only partial downstream view is possible, water droplets still at lens edge. Audio: water, drip, insects returning, distant gunfire.

scenes.title: Heat and Exhaustion
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine wipes sweat and rain from eyes.
scenes.imageDescription: Tired muddy Marine, foxhole, rifle resting, no active combat.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman rests too; near-still close view from cramped position, focus breathes between muddy sleeve and face, no staged push-in. Audio: breath, insects, drip, very distant artillery.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator rises with patrol after rest.

scenes.title: Patrol Moves Again
scenes.description: The section reforms along narrow green corridor.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine falls into line and moves deeper.
scenes.imageDescription: Darker wetter jungle trail, patrol moving away, accumulated mud.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator follows from rear with leaves and packs constantly occluding view; no clean tracking lane. Camera rhythm matches tired walking. Audio: boots, wet leaves, insects, gear.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera remains under canopy behind patrol.

scenes.title: Dusk Under Canopy
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine advances in deepening dusk.
scenes.imageDescription: Dim canopy, wet leaves reflecting low light, no visible enemy.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator struggles with low light; exposure breathes and focus hunts through dark foliage while he stays close behind. No artificial cinematic light. Audio: evening insects, distant gunshot, breath.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator reaches night foxhole with patrol.

scenes.title: Flashes Beyond the Trees
scenes.description: Distant flashes briefly illuminate jungle at night.
scenes.imageDescription: Dark jungle defensive position, wet logs, distant flashes.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera stays almost still at foxhole edge; exposure jumps imperfectly with each distant flash, droplets sparkle then vanish. Audio: insects, distant combat, rain drip.

scenes.title: Wet Dawn
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine steps onto trail again with same unit.
scenes.imageDescription: Misty jungle dawn, wet foliage, exhausted Marines.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator emerges from cover behind them, lens still spotted; one sleeve wipes edge imperfectly, leaving smear, then tired follow begins. Audio: morning birds, wet leaves, boots, distant battle.

scenes.title: Swallowed by the Jungle
scenes.description: The patrol disappears behind dense foliage.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine follows patrol around bend and vanishes.
scenes.imageDescription: Long jungle corridor, receding patrol, dense wet canopy, no victory gesture.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator stops rather than forcing through another thicket; holds from human shoulder height as foliage naturally hides the patrol. Leaves sway into frame. No aerial reveal. Audio: insects, wet footsteps fading, distant war only.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Final frame is empty wet jungle trail.
